SaveScummer

Create checkpoints in games that don't offer them.

Retry a tough moment, learn faster, and spend less time replaying what you already know, so you can get back to the stories, builds, and choices you care about.

Supported games

I chose games where progress is costly to lose.

There are too many games to suffer through the slog!
